item.title: Firefighters battle 70 acres of wildfires in Marion County as Putnam residents evacuated
item.description: Firefighters battled dry and windy conditions on Saturday as they responded to multiple wildfires across 70 acres of land in Marion County, including one next to the county's border with Putnam, where a separate massive blaze has forced temporary evacuations. Read more: Firefighters battle 70 acres of wildfires in Marion County as Putnam residents evacuated

item.title: Burning railroad ties in Marion County produce potentially toxic fumes
item.description: A significant fire involving a large stockpile of chemically-coated railroad ties in Dunnellon was reported by Marion County Fire Rescue early Sunday, continuing a weekend that has already seen dozens of local acres impacted by wildfire.
